meta.name: Warehouse — Section 2 Loading Bay
meta.mode: Unique warehouse layouts — Section 1 long aisles, Section 2 cross-rack loading bay
meta.axes: Three.js X/Z world axes, Y up. In the top-down reference render, positive X appears toward screen-left and positive Z toward screen-top; numbered sections follow that visible blueprint orientation.
meta.note: Section 1 keeps four long north-south rack runs. Section 2 is deliberately different: three crosswise east-west rack rows, a static low-poly forklift with wheels, mast, forks and overhead guard parked in the wide outer staging lane, a correctly sized marked parking bay, industrial drums, safety cones, staged spare pallets and a utility workbench. The original 202-wall shell is unchanged. Sections 3–4 and central hall remain props-free.
meta.sectionArchitecture: Each numbered quadrant has an enclosing chamber, recessed entry returns, two cross-corridor links, one side-aisle link, and three auxiliary service bays. All quadrant wall geometry is mirrored on both axes.

sectionProgress.section1: long north-south pallet-rack aisles; 20 pallet bases and 32 crate loads
sectionProgress.section2: unique east-west cross-racks; static forklift loading bay; drums, safety cones, spare pallets and workbench
